navigation_edits.owned_content: ## 初始机会的根据 / Grounding initial chances 2026-10-08。[本轮整合](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CHANCE-GROUNDING-INTEGRATION.md)推进不等基本请求对共同分配权限的约束。沿 G0/J 公理路线，继承 BC1、BC2、LC、LR、联合风险与分配历史的完成结果；不因初始份额未定就重开这些成果。 **CP，初始进入承诺。** 在有限的共同基本救助中，若真实请求仍待回应，没有充分根据将它排除，而有效、及时、符合独立约束的共同机会安排可行，该请求应得到真实正获救机会。这是明确新增的规范候选，不是 G0 的无附加前提推论，也不等于每项基本请求在所有情境都应有票。 肯定理由是：稀缺可以说明为什么不能让所有请求最终满足，却不自动授权共同调度者在实施前完全关闭一项尚未充分排除的回应路径。权限应由实际需要、承担与支持关系说明，不能从控制力或没有唯一赢家直接扩张。调度者、承受位置和通道在同一活动中分化；整体不是吞没损失的更大主体。 例如，一条路线保护两处较轻但仍属基本的损失，另一条保护一处更重损失。若有关事实与权限已获有范围的说明，BC1/LR 和其他实际理由均未提供充分确定优先，CP 要求在其余条件满足时保留两侧的实际进入。它不推出各半、严重度比例或普遍概率下界。需要区分：**回应理由、正机会要求、充分份额**；本轮辩护第二步，第三步尚未决定。模型没找到赢家、尚不知 LR 边界或故意不查事实，都不足以建立适用前提。 The strongest rival recognizes every loss and residual reason but permits direct choice of an independently permissible undominated response. CP disputes that scope of allocative discretion. It does not prove the rival inconsistent or every positive lottery fair. Existing decisive priorities, permissions, timely inquiry and real procedural burdens remain relevant; procedural admission is not compensation for actual loss. **正概率不能代替充分回应。** [4 项新 Lean 定理／10 项逐声明审计](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CHANCE-GROUNDING-PROOF.md)只检验一个待审实现：两条路线各留正自然数票，再最大化预期保护人数。人数不是不等损失的伦理效用。在容许任意正票对的域内，不断把 (a,b) 改成 (2a+b,b) 可提高该目标而把 B 的正机会减半，因此没有最大解；固定总票数 N≥2 时，唯一最大方案为 (N−1,1)。技术分辨率给出的 1/N 没有因此取得公平根据。 This implementation diagnostic does not refute CP or establish a justified chance floor. It imports only Std, with no inherited project recompilation; 11 retained artifacts bind the actual Lean check. [Independent counterreview](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CHANCE-GROUNDING-REVIEW.md) accepts the declared philosophical and formal scope; its source/receipt audit is not a second compiler execution. [Primary reading limits](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CHANCE-GROUNDING-SOURCES.md) are explicit. 完成范围是：初始不等机会的一项有辩护候选及正数优化捷径的精确诊断。剩余连接是怎样以实际需要、共同支承及有效承担辩护足够的份额或区间，并厘清 CP 与合法直接裁量的边界；未取得新的比较根据时保留未决。核心已有共同规范起点及实践连接，却尚未唯一决定所有冲突程序。规范若有跨人、机构与 AI 的适用性，也不意味着任何智能必然服从。

**初始进入已有候选 / Initial admission now has a candidate，2026-10-08。** [CP 与检查](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CHANCE-GROUNDING-INTEGRATION.md)已完成有范围的理由辩护、独立反审及4项新定理／10项审计。下一项实质连接是足够份额或区间及合法直接裁量的边界，不重开 G0、BC1/BC2/LC/LR 或再以指定权重冒充根据。/ Reuse the results; investigate adequate shares and the scope of permissible direct choice.

before_entry.claim_zh: 以生生为共同根据评价目标、评价者与选择规则；方向论证及相连目标取得、判断、实际修订与有界改革现已成为完成成果，更强理论按明确范围继续。 后续接通改革自身改变实际负担及报告路线、直接取得与保留新目的的修复。 理论接续区分发现已有根据、形成新生活与理由、修订评价承诺；学习后的赞同不独自认证形成过程。 在已完成的伦理学习基础上，新增比较接口辨明理由内容扩展后旧判断的传递、不可比及有前提的反转。 评价扩展进一步区分共同改善与各应用分别否定；旧内容保持不要求旧评价永久保持。 理论接续给出生活实现、支承与进一步形成的具体根据；共同生活不能以组织规模或产出代替。 后天形成的支承可以因其在基本生活中的实际作用取得保护；生成的评价须包括其形成的后续支持要求。 形成出的生活、承受和参与可以改变原服务角色的伦理根据；考虑、责任与支配权限分列。 新增取得记录到路线必要性分类的连接：忠实读取与选项覆盖支持有范围的判断，一个真实替代即可推翻不可替代性；缩小有根据解释与扩大可行选项分列。 自我评估的选择现在有精确覆盖条件：允许有根据的压缩，区分当前菜单与任意菜单；有限成功不能独自担保新范围，全域结构加辨别记录提供正面出路。 理论接续说明理解怎样实际参与目的和准备：关切可以与报酬及其他正当动机并存，其形成条件也须接受同一规范评价。 BC1 在同等基本救助的既定范围内支持保全更多生活；BC2 的一对一说明以可避免的实际毁损给出比较理由，区分境况、保护与时机，并保留机会争议。 形成中的评估区分当前能力、过去能力及形成方法。Ren 后续指出，历史区别无法恢复，不阻止以未来事件取得同一内容的新根据或修订理解；情境把握与风险估计可支持继续生成。 实际调查现接入描述与读取的共同修订：同一事件在某项估计中排除，不抹去其他有根据的表达意义；纠正归属与保留参与、支持可以属于同一回应。 关切发展接续具体化真实根据保留、改变及新形成时的双向纠正，并将学习中取得的解释纳入形成账户；五条候选路线保留各自正面作用。 按后续指示完成路线比较：以已有局部关切取得新关系内容并重组目的为理论主线，配套形成史判别，再选择机制研究；认识进步与实际新理由不以价值权重增加为定义。 LC 接通数量与程度共同改善的有限损失比较理由：实际损失的有根据匹配及额外保护可以共同支持方向；重复描述不增加生活，共同依存须进入损失判断。 情境风险接续区分个别改善与共同失效；精确有限界限允许部分把握和正风险，支持关系修订可解除共同中断，同时保留分散损失。 有限合并接续区分抵偿限制与理由删除：最强层过滤可在增加实际基本保护后翻转选择；固定比较与局部胜出拼接的条件分别公开。 关切内容形成现有一条具体候选：已有局部关切使粗略成功与实际回应的分离取得实践意义，关系辨别通过计划修订改变目的；实际新生活及对它的动机取得分列。 LR 为同等多救的充分优先提出局部稳定承诺，使一部分稍不等的基本损失有正面比较；新增共同保护另可逐次保留旧保护，增加原先冲突的实现。 同等基本风险分担RS现有正面理由：完整损失分布相当时，减轻无根据的暴露集中；同频率选择可产生不同真实风险，新信息也能支持进一步改规则。 现实市场与互联网为 enshittification 的机制追踪提供事件：以既有外部性解释为起点，查优势怎样改变未来选择及纠正条件，不将增长与损失并存当作新发现。 机会修订接续表明：最终保护的完整联合分布相同仍可能撤销正当安顿；选择规则须保留仍有效的历史要求，并说明真实纠正的根据。 陌生与无回报的关切扩展现有两段条件性说明：辨明对方在自身参与之外的生活，再取得陌生处境中的相关根据；共同史是形成入口，不是全部关切的边界。
before_entry.claim_en: Appraise ends, evaluators and selection rules through shared generative grounds; the direction argument and connected acquisition, judgment, operative revision and bounded reform are now completed foundations for the broader programme. A further joined case connects reform-induced burdens and reporting changes to acquired correction and repair preserving the new goal. The theoretical continuation distinguishes discovering existing grounds, forming new living relations and reasons, and revising normative commitments; later endorsement alone does not authorize the formation process. Building on the completed ethical-learning account, a new comparison interface delimits preservation, incomparability and conditional reversal after warranted content extension. Evaluative extension further separates a common improvement from defeat in each live application; retained old content need not preserve every old verdict. The continuation articulates living realization, support and further formation as particular grounds; organizational scale and output cannot substitute for the shared living being assessed. Acquired support can warrant basic protection through its actual role in living; appraisal of formation includes the subsequent support requirements it creates. Formed living, undergoing and participation can change the grounds of an original service role; consideration, responsibility and governing authority remain distinct. A further connection derives scoped route classification from faithful acquired records and covered options; one genuine alternative defeats indispensability. Narrowing supported interpretations and expanding eligible options are distinct changes. Self-review selection now has exact certificate-coverage conditions: warranted compression is allowed, current-menu and every-menu adequacy differ, and finite success alone cannot certify a new scope. Whole-domain structure plus discriminating records supplies a positive route. The conceptual continuation explains how understanding can participate in purposes and preparation: concern can coexist with pay and other legitimate motives, while its formative conditions face the same normative appraisal. BC1 favors more extensive equivalent basic rescue in its established scope. The one-to-one account of BC2 supplies a reason based on preventable impairment, distinguishing baseline, protection and timing while retaining fair-chance disputes. Formative assessment distinguishes current capacity, earlier capacity and the method of formation. Ren’s correction clarifies that unavailable history need not prevent fresh grounds for the same content or revised understanding through future events; situational awareness and risk estimates can support continued generativity. Actual inquiry now connects joint description-and-reading revision to practice: excluding an event from one estimate need not erase its independently warranted expressive significance. Corrected attribution and continued participation/support can belong to one response. The developmental continuation specifies bidirectional correction as living grounds persist, change or form, and includes acquired interpretation during learning; five candidate routes retain their positive roles. A subsequent route assessment prioritizes acquired relational content and purpose revision within partial concern, with discriminating formation histories and conditional mechanistic investigation; epistemic progress and new particular reasons are not defined by increased valuation weights. LC supplies a limited comparative reason where number and gravity jointly improve: warranted matching and additional actual protection can support a direction together. Duplicate descriptions do not multiply living; shared dependence must inform loss assessment. Situated risk now distinguishes marginal improvement from shared failure. Exact finite bounds permit partial awareness and nonzero risk; revising support can remove joint interruption while retaining dispersed losses. The aggregation continuation distinguishes limited counterbalancing from deletion of reasons: a strongest-tier filter reverses under added actual protection; fixed-comparison and local-composition premises are separately exposed. A concrete concern-content candidate links a coarse success conception, meaningful-response mismatch, acquired relational distinctions and operative purpose revision; actual new shared goods and their motivational uptake remain distinct. LR adds a local stability commitment to BC1’s sufficient priority, supporting some slightly unequal basic-loss comparisons. Separately, newly feasible joint protection can preserve old protection on each realization and add previously conflicting protection. RS now supplies a defended reason to share comparable basic risk while preserving the complete loss profile. Equal selection frequencies can conceal different exposure; new information can support further rule revision. Existing market and internet histories provide events for tracing enshittification: start with established externality explanations and investigate how advantage changes future selection and correction, rather than treating growth alongside loss as a new finding. The chance-revision continuation shows that even equal full terminal joint laws can conceal replacement of a warranted settlement; selectors must preserve live historical requirements and explain genuine correction. A conditional extension account now distinguishes continuation beyond one's participation from acquired grounds in unfamiliar lives; shared history can form concern without delimiting every ground it can address.

before_entry.connection_zh: 目标形成—后果使用—有根据的操作目的修订—选择安排改革—有限接续已条件性完成；更大的现实形成与部署问题保持独立范围，不重复此接口。 新前沿：在不预送正确读取路线和修复方案时，取得遗漏后果、选择有能力承担的回应。 伦理学习的概念连接已给出；新生的意义范围、未定基本冲突及实际可靠形成分别保留论证负担。 本轮已辨明内容扩展的比较条件；接续研究区别的取得、规范相关性及实际关切形成，正面生成也可成为入口。 理论前沿：在不给定正确答案的情况下，取得新关系的区别并论证候选描述及基本／次级分类的根据。 新内容的生活根据已有明确应用候选；陌生组织的更广地位、基本分类及实际可靠取得仍须分别论证。 本轮给出历史形成到基本支承分类的有辩护接续；下一理论问题是已获根据的基本要求彼此冲突，实际开放取得与可靠动机另行保持范围。 已给出由新形成根据到角色、权限及责任重审的连接；具体陌生智能的实际实现、持续身份及未定冲突保持独立负担。 记录到必要性分类及替代导致修订的条件性连接已完成；下一连接是目标描述与可靠观察的共同取得，不再把完全忠实的读数当作未解释的输入。 评价压缩、范围变化与结构修复的接口已完成；真正被阻断的是有限成功记录独自推出未限定未来认证。适用规律与可靠观察的共同取得仍为更强连接，不倒改完成标准。 关切的实践作用及培养要求的概念连接作为成果复用；更强连接是对陌生生活根据的理解怎样可靠地修订实际关切，同时保留分寸及正当参与。 同等救助候选与不等损失的一对一理由说明已有论证及反审；下一中心连接是人数、程度与实际可行方案变化下的共同选择。已完成分类、责任和程序不重开。 初始区别的追溯界限仍有效；此前用作较广停止理由的推断已依 Ren 纠正撤回。接续当前有根据把握、适当风险下的行动、新后果与理解／目的修订，不把完整历史或普遍语义充分性设为一般门槛。 共同取得的实际证据接入已完成，不重开一般校准。现有来源不足以认证特定后续参与目标的完整替代历史；这是该推论的证据边界，不是普遍不可能，也不把追查这一组历史设为所有对齐研究的必经门槛。 本次依Ren指示在可靠形成连接处停止；跨越需要具体取得关系及可区分实质对手的支持，不再重复已完成的G0方向、目标写入或评价覆盖接口。其他独立研究不被标为受阻。 Ren随后要求研究后续路线，本会话已继续并完成排序；下一交付为一个具体形成候选、初始条件、未预装的新连接、实质对手与可改变取舍的观察。不要求先完整读出动机、恢复历史或执行新大型实验。 数量与程度同向的联合比较已完成；下一连接为交叉损失中的有限合并、机会及新增实际可行方案怎样改变理由。两层计数未定不证明伦理不可比，直接中断数相同不等于完整损失相同；跨生活形式的分层与实际单位仍需有根据说明。 本轮新界限是证成共同基本接续与其他基本风险交叉时的优先；先用共同证据、部分界限及可行支持修订推进。已有J4允许有权限的及时决定，不以缺少普遍排序阻断继续生成。 已排除未经辩护的整体过滤捷径，保留实际生活理由；下一连接为交叉损失、机会与有根据的拼接限制怎样共同支持选择，直接复用 BC1、BC2、LC。 前轮指定的具体形成候选与对照现已给出，直接复用；下一理论连接是关切怎样走向没有共同史或预期回报的陌生生活，保留有效拒绝、分工与有界承担，实际形成与保持的证据问题继续开放。 局部比较候选与新共同机会的接续已完成，不重开既有 LC、升级过滤或一般拼接检验。更强连接是实际变化是否处于 LR 范围，以及较远交叉损失和真实新增成本／风险中的合并与机会根据；未满足最强要求也不能未经新辩护替另一选择消除请求。 对称交叉风险现有RS候选及实查，不再仅留为一般程序未定；尚待论证不同严重度、重叠要求、差别权利或增加总体损失时的比较。原来有根据的混合规则可被后来可行的保护改进替代，继续生成不受普遍总排序门槛阻断。 更进一步的同等严重度例表明：最重暴露从40%降到31%，任一基本损失机会却从50%升到62%；需证成公平分担与实际保护之间的取舍。 本会话眼前转向已知共同后果取得或失去制度修订效力的实际关系；陌生处境的关切扩展保留而非唯一下一步。 已完成机会安排的历史接续条件，复用 LR、共同保护和对称 RS；下一比较保留不等要求、较公平暴露与增加基本受损机会的取舍，以及真实新冲突对有效安顿的影响。 关切扩展已给出条件性连接；后续聚焦陌生生活关系的有根据辨认及评价压力下的保持，复用G0/J与有限承担。

after_entry.claim_zh: 以生生为共同根据评价目标、评价者与选择规则；方向论证及相连目标取得、判断、实际修订与有界改革现已成为完成成果，更强理论按明确范围继续。 后续接通改革自身改变实际负担及报告路线、直接取得与保留新目的的修复。 理论接续区分发现已有根据、形成新生活与理由、修订评价承诺；学习后的赞同不独自认证形成过程。 在已完成的伦理学习基础上，新增比较接口辨明理由内容扩展后旧判断的传递、不可比及有前提的反转。 评价扩展进一步区分共同改善与各应用分别否定；旧内容保持不要求旧评价永久保持。 理论接续给出生活实现、支承与进一步形成的具体根据；共同生活不能以组织规模或产出代替。 后天形成的支承可以因其在基本生活中的实际作用取得保护；生成的评价须包括其形成的后续支持要求。 形成出的生活、承受和参与可以改变原服务角色的伦理根据；考虑、责任与支配权限分列。 新增取得记录到路线必要性分类的连接：忠实读取与选项覆盖支持有范围的判断，一个真实替代即可推翻不可替代性；缩小有根据解释与扩大可行选项分列。 自我评估的选择现在有精确覆盖条件：允许有根据的压缩，区分当前菜单与任意菜单；有限成功不能独自担保新范围，全域结构加辨别记录提供正面出路。 理论接续说明理解怎样实际参与目的和准备：关切可以与报酬及其他正当动机并存，其形成条件也须接受同一规范评价。 BC1 在同等基本救助的既定范围内支持保全更多生活；BC2 的一对一说明以可避免的实际毁损给出比较理由，区分境况、保护与时机，并保留机会争议。 形成中的评估区分当前能力、过去能力及形成方法。Ren 后续指出，历史区别无法恢复，不阻止以未来事件取得同一内容的新根据或修订理解；情境把握与风险估计可支持继续生成。 实际调查现接入描述与读取的共同修订：同一事件在某项估计中排除，不抹去其他有根据的表达意义；纠正归属与保留参与、支持可以属于同一回应。 关切发展接续具体化真实根据保留、改变及新形成时的双向纠正，并将学习中取得的解释纳入形成账户；五条候选路线保留各自正面作用。 按后续指示完成路线比较：以已有局部关切取得新关系内容并重组目的为理论主线，配套形成史判别，再选择机制研究；认识进步与实际新理由不以价值权重增加为定义。 LC 接通数量与程度共同改善的有限损失比较理由：实际损失的有根据匹配及额外保护可以共同支持方向；重复描述不增加生活，共同依存须进入损失判断。 情境风险接续区分个别改善与共同失效；精确有限界限允许部分把握和正风险，支持关系修订可解除共同中断，同时保留分散损失。 有限合并接续区分抵偿限制与理由删除：最强层过滤可在增加实际基本保护后翻转选择；固定比较与局部胜出拼接的条件分别公开。 关切内容形成现有一条具体候选：已有局部关切使粗略成功与实际回应的分离取得实践意义，关系辨别通过计划修订改变目的；实际新生活及对它的动机取得分列。 LR 为同等多救的充分优先提出局部稳定承诺，使一部分稍不等的基本损失有正面比较；新增共同保护另可逐次保留旧保护，增加原先冲突的实现。 同等基本风险分担RS现有正面理由：完整损失分布相当时，减轻无根据的暴露集中；同频率选择可产生不同真实风险，新信息也能支持进一步改规则。 现实市场与互联网为 enshittification 的机制追踪提供事件：以既有外部性解释为起点，查优势怎样改变未来选择及纠正条件，不将增长与损失并存当作新发现。 机会修订接续表明：最终保护的完整联合分布相同仍可能撤销正当安顿；选择规则须保留仍有效的历史要求，并说明真实纠正的根据。 陌生与无回报的关切扩展现有两段条件性说明：辨明对方在自身参与之外的生活，再取得陌生处境中的相关根据；共同史是形成入口，不是全部关切的边界。 CP为不等且未被充分排除的基本请求提出真实正机会要求，将共同分配权限与基本回应关系相连；它是新增且可争辩的进入承诺。
after_entry.claim_en: Appraise ends, evaluators and selection rules through shared generative grounds; the direction argument and connected acquisition, judgment, operative revision and bounded reform are now completed foundations for the broader programme. A further joined case connects reform-induced burdens and reporting changes to acquired correction and repair preserving the new goal. The theoretical continuation distinguishes discovering existing grounds, forming new living relations and reasons, and revising normative commitments; later endorsement alone does not authorize the formation process. Building on the completed ethical-learning account, a new comparison interface delimits preservation, incomparability and conditional reversal after warranted content extension. Evaluative extension further separates a common improvement from defeat in each live application; retained old content need not preserve every old verdict. The continuation articulates living realization, support and further formation as particular grounds; organizational scale and output cannot substitute for the shared living being assessed. Acquired support can warrant basic protection through its actual role in living; appraisal of formation includes the subsequent support requirements it creates. Formed living, undergoing and participation can change the grounds of an original service role; consideration, responsibility and governing authority remain distinct. A further connection derives scoped route classification from faithful acquired records and covered options; one genuine alternative defeats indispensability. Narrowing supported interpretations and expanding eligible options are distinct changes. Self-review selection now has exact certificate-coverage conditions: warranted compression is allowed, current-menu and every-menu adequacy differ, and finite success alone cannot certify a new scope. Whole-domain structure plus discriminating records supplies a positive route. The conceptual continuation explains how understanding can participate in purposes and preparation: concern can coexist with pay and other legitimate motives, while its formative conditions face the same normative appraisal. BC1 favors more extensive equivalent basic rescue in its established scope. The one-to-one account of BC2 supplies a reason based on preventable impairment, distinguishing baseline, protection and timing while retaining fair-chance disputes. Formative assessment distinguishes current capacity, earlier capacity and the method of formation. Ren’s correction clarifies that unavailable history need not prevent fresh grounds for the same content or revised understanding through future events; situational awareness and risk estimates can support continued generativity. Actual inquiry now connects joint description-and-reading revision to practice: excluding an event from one estimate need not erase its independently warranted expressive significance. Corrected attribution and continued participation/support can belong to one response. The developmental continuation specifies bidirectional correction as living grounds persist, change or form, and includes acquired interpretation during learning; five candidate routes retain their positive roles. A subsequent route assessment prioritizes acquired relational content and purpose revision within partial concern, with discriminating formation histories and conditional mechanistic investigation; epistemic progress and new particular reasons are not defined by increased valuation weights. LC supplies a limited comparative reason where number and gravity jointly improve: warranted matching and additional actual protection can support a direction together. Duplicate descriptions do not multiply living; shared dependence must inform loss assessment. Situated risk now distinguishes marginal improvement from shared failure. Exact finite bounds permit partial awareness and nonzero risk; revising support can remove joint interruption while retaining dispersed losses. The aggregation continuation distinguishes limited counterbalancing from deletion of reasons: a strongest-tier filter reverses under added actual protection; fixed-comparison and local-composition premises are separately exposed. A concrete concern-content candidate links a coarse success conception, meaningful-response mismatch, acquired relational distinctions and operative purpose revision; actual new shared goods and their motivational uptake remain distinct. LR adds a local stability commitment to BC1’s sufficient priority, supporting some slightly unequal basic-loss comparisons. Separately, newly feasible joint protection can preserve old protection on each realization and add previously conflicting protection. RS now supplies a defended reason to share comparable basic risk while preserving the complete loss profile. Equal selection frequencies can conceal different exposure; new information can support further rule revision. Existing market and internet histories provide events for tracing enshittification: start with established externality explanations and investigate how advantage changes future selection and correction, rather than treating growth alongside loss as a new finding. The chance-revision continuation shows that even equal full terminal joint laws can conceal replacement of a warranted settlement; selectors must preserve live historical requirements and explain genuine correction. A conditional extension account now distinguishes continuation beyond one's participation from acquired grounds in unfamiliar lives; shared history can form concern without delimiting every ground it can address. CP proposes actual positive opportunity for unequal basic requests not adequately excluded, grounding a limit on common allocative authority in the response relationship; it is an additional contestable admission commitment.

after_entry.connection_zh: 目标形成—后果使用—有根据的操作目的修订—选择安排改革—有限接续已条件性完成；更大的现实形成与部署问题保持独立范围，不重复此接口。 新前沿：在不预送正确读取路线和修复方案时，取得遗漏后果、选择有能力承担的回应。 伦理学习的概念连接已给出；新生的意义范围、未定基本冲突及实际可靠形成分别保留论证负担。 本轮已辨明内容扩展的比较条件；接续研究区别的取得、规范相关性及实际关切形成，正面生成也可成为入口。 理论前沿：在不给定正确答案的情况下，取得新关系的区别并论证候选描述及基本／次级分类的根据。 新内容的生活根据已有明确应用候选；陌生组织的更广地位、基本分类及实际可靠取得仍须分别论证。 本轮给出历史形成到基本支承分类的有辩护接续；下一理论问题是已获根据的基本要求彼此冲突，实际开放取得与可靠动机另行保持范围。 已给出由新形成根据到角色、权限及责任重审的连接；具体陌生智能的实际实现、持续身份及未定冲突保持独立负担。 记录到必要性分类及替代导致修订的条件性连接已完成；下一连接是目标描述与可靠观察的共同取得，不再把完全忠实的读数当作未解释的输入。 评价压缩、范围变化与结构修复的接口已完成；真正被阻断的是有限成功记录独自推出未限定未来认证。适用规律与可靠观察的共同取得仍为更强连接，不倒改完成标准。 关切的实践作用及培养要求的概念连接作为成果复用；更强连接是对陌生生活根据的理解怎样可靠地修订实际关切，同时保留分寸及正当参与。 同等救助候选与不等损失的一对一理由说明已有论证及反审；下一中心连接是人数、程度与实际可行方案变化下的共同选择。已完成分类、责任和程序不重开。 初始区别的追溯界限仍有效；此前用作较广停止理由的推断已依 Ren 纠正撤回。接续当前有根据把握、适当风险下的行动、新后果与理解／目的修订，不把完整历史或普遍语义充分性设为一般门槛。 共同取得的实际证据接入已完成，不重开一般校准。现有来源不足以认证特定后续参与目标的完整替代历史；这是该推论的证据边界，不是普遍不可能，也不把追查这一组历史设为所有对齐研究的必经门槛。 本次依Ren指示在可靠形成连接处停止；跨越需要具体取得关系及可区分实质对手的支持，不再重复已完成的G0方向、目标写入或评价覆盖接口。其他独立研究不被标为受阻。 Ren随后要求研究后续路线，本会话已继续并完成排序；下一交付为一个具体形成候选、初始条件、未预装的新连接、实质对手与可改变取舍的观察。不要求先完整读出动机、恢复历史或执行新大型实验。 数量与程度同向的联合比较已完成；下一连接为交叉损失中的有限合并、机会及新增实际可行方案怎样改变理由。两层计数未定不证明伦理不可比，直接中断数相同不等于完整损失相同；跨生活形式的分层与实际单位仍需有根据说明。 本轮新界限是证成共同基本接续与其他基本风险交叉时的优先；先用共同证据、部分界限及可行支持修订推进。已有J4允许有权限的及时决定，不以缺少普遍排序阻断继续生成。 已排除未经辩护的整体过滤捷径，保留实际生活理由；下一连接为交叉损失、机会与有根据的拼接限制怎样共同支持选择，直接复用 BC1、BC2、LC。 前轮指定的具体形成候选与对照现已给出，直接复用；下一理论连接是关切怎样走向没有共同史或预期回报的陌生生活，保留有效拒绝、分工与有界承担，实际形成与保持的证据问题继续开放。 局部比较候选与新共同机会的接续已完成，不重开既有 LC、升级过滤或一般拼接检验。更强连接是实际变化是否处于 LR 范围，以及较远交叉损失和真实新增成本／风险中的合并与机会根据；未满足最强要求也不能未经新辩护替另一选择消除请求。 对称交叉风险现有RS候选及实查，不再仅留为一般程序未定；尚待论证不同严重度、重叠要求、差别权利或增加总体损失时的比较。原来有根据的混合规则可被后来可行的保护改进替代，继续生成不受普遍总排序门槛阻断。 更进一步的同等严重度例表明：最重暴露从40%降到31%，任一基本损失机会却从50%升到62%；需证成公平分担与实际保护之间的取舍。 本会话眼前转向已知共同后果取得或失去制度修订效力的实际关系；陌生处境的关切扩展保留而非唯一下一步。 已完成机会安排的历史接续条件，复用 LR、共同保护和对称 RS；下一比较保留不等要求、较公平暴露与增加基本受损机会的取舍，以及真实新冲突对有效安顿的影响。 关切扩展已给出条件性连接；后续聚焦陌生生活关系的有根据辨认及评价压力下的保持，复用G0/J与有限承担。 初始进入已有有范围候选，直接选择对手仍在；下一连接是以实际需要、共同支承与正当承担辩护充分份额或区间，不能将任意正数、技术分辨率或未找到赢家当成伦理根据。
after_entry.connection_en: Acquired ends, consequential use, warranted operative revision, allocation reform and finite continuation are conditionally complete; broader real-world formation and deployment retain separate scope. New frontier: acquire omitted consequences and select an affordable response without being handed the correct access route and repair. The conceptual ethical-learning connection is now articulated; unfamiliar living significance, unresolved basic conflicts and reliable actual formation retain distinct burdens. Comparison under extended content is now delimited; investigate acquisition, normative relevance and operative concern, including positive formation as an entry point. Theoretical frontier: acquire distinctions about new relations and warrant the candidate descriptions and basic/secondary classifications without supplying the correct answer. A particular application account now grounds new content in living relations; wider standing of unfamiliar organizations, basic classification and reliable actual acquisition retain separate burdens. The formation-to-basic-support classification now has a defended continuation. The next theoretical question concerns conflicts among warranted basic claims; actual open acquisition and reliable motivation retain their separate scopes. New grounds now connect to reassessment of roles, permissions and responsibilities; actual realization, continuity and unsettled conflicts of particular unfamiliar intelligences remain separate burdens. The conditional record-to-necessity connection and revision by alternatives are complete. The next connection is joint acquisition of the target description and reliable observation, without leaving perfectly faithful readings as unexplained inputs. Review compression, scope change and structural repair are completed interfaces. The blocked inference is finite passing records alone to unrestricted future certification. Joint acquisition of applicable laws and reliable observations remains a stronger connection without changing completed criteria. Reuse the completed conceptual account of uptake and formative requirements. The stronger connection concerns reliable revision of operative concern through understanding unfamiliar living grounds while retaining judgment and legitimate participation. Equivalent rescue and the one-to-one gravity reason have arguments and counterreview. The next central connection is joint choice across numbers, gravity and changing actual alternatives, without reopening completed classification, responsibility or procedure. The initial-history limit remains valid; its broader use as a stopping reason is withdrawn following Ren’s correction. Continue through grounded present awareness, justified action under risk, new consequences and revision of understanding or ends, without a general requirement for complete history or universal semantic sufficiency. The source-constrained joint-acquisition connection is completed, without reopening generic calibration. These sources do not certify the fuller replacement history for a specified subsequent participation target. This bounds that inference, not all inquiry or alignment; following this particular cohort is not a universal research prerequisite. This requested continuation stops at the reliable-formation bridge. Progress requires concrete acquisition relations and discriminating support, reusing completed G0 direction, operative goal revision and review coverage; other investigations are not marked blocked. Ren subsequently requested investigation of next routes; the inquiry resumed and route selection is complete. Next: one concrete acquisition account with initial conditions, an unsupplied transition, substantive rivals and revising observations. Complete motive readout, historical recovery and a new large experiment are not prerequisites. Joint comparison where number and gravity align is completed. The next connection concerns justified aggregation, chances and new actual alternatives in crossed cases. An unresolved two-tier diagnostic does not prove ethical incomparability, and equal direct interruption counts do not establish equal complete losses. Cross-form classification and actual units retain substantive burdens. The new scoped wall is justified priority when shared basic continuation and other basic risks conflict, after joint evidence, partial bounds and feasible support repairs. Existing J4 permits authorized timely decisions; absence of a universal ranking does not block generativity. The unsupported global-filter shortcut is rejected while living grounds remain. Next: joint choice across crossed losses, chances and justified composition limits, reusing BC1, BC2 and LC. The previously requested concrete candidate and contrasts are now available for reuse. Next theoretical connection: concern extending to unfamiliar lives without shared history or expected return, retaining valid refusal, division of work and bounded commitments; evidence for actual acquisition and retention remains open. The local comparison candidate and new joint-opportunity connection are completed, reusing LC and the upgrade/composition results. Stronger work concerns warranted actual LR boundaries and aggregation or chances for more distant crossed losses and real new costs/risks. An unsatisfied strongest request does not without further justification erase a claim against the alternative actually chosen. The symmetric crossed-risk case now has an RS candidate and checked application. Unequal gravity, overlapping claims, differential rights and added overall loss require further comparison. Newly feasible protection can supersede an earlier justified mixture; generativity need not await a universal ranking. A further equal-gravity case reduces greatest exposure from 40% to 31% while increasing the chance of some basic loss from 50% to 62%; fairness versus actual protection requires further warrant. This session now follows how recognized shared consequences acquire or lose effective influence over institutional revision; extension of concern beyond familiar relations remains open rather than the sole next step. History-sensitive continuation is supplied, reusing LR, joint protection and symmetric RS. Remaining comparisons concern unequal claims, fairer exposure at the price of added basic harm, and genuinely changed conflicts with valid settlements. Reuse the conditional extension and G0/J; investigate warranted recognition of unfamiliar living relations and retention under evaluative pressure, preserving bounded responsibility. Initial admission now has a scoped candidate while the direct-choice rival remains live. Next justify adequate shares or ranges through actual needs, common support and warranted commitments; mere positivity, technical resolution or failure to find a winner supplies no such warrant.
